prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 深化论证段，或论文 Motivation 强化段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想在议论文或科研立项书中，通过严密的“反事实推演（If we fail to... / Absent X...）”强化紧迫感与说服力。”。请严格按照 `BP39` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L009`（分类矩阵综述法：拒绝 A did X, B did Y 流水账（Taxonomy over Laundry List）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Curating clean human data is very important. If we do not use clean human data and only use AI-generated data to train new AI models, the models will become worse and worse and finally collapse.
structural_constraints: S1 [正面基准命题 Positive Baseline]：Maintaining rigorous [Principle/Standard X] serves as the primary safeguard against [Systemic Risk Y].
S2 [反事实假设切入 Counterfactual Premise]：Absent this safeguard—if [Actors] were to rely exclusively on [Unchecked Alternative]—[Immediate Vulnerability] would quickly emerge.
S3 [连锁恶化传导 Cascading Deterioration]：Once [Immediate Vulnerability] takes hold, [Secondary Consequence] compounds across cycles, eventually eroding [Core Foundation].
S4 [实证印证或结论锁定 Empirical Echo]：This degradation dynamic mirrors [Real-world/Technical Precedent], underscoring why [Principle X] cannot be compromised for short-term convenience.

消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: We use ETT, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic datasets. We compare with Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, and DLinear. We use MSE and MAE as metrics, and the lookback window is 96.
structural_constraints: S1 [重申核心权衡与立场 Restate Nuanced Thesis]：In conclusion, while [Acknowledged Factor A] introduces real challenges in [Specific Aspect], [Core Thesis Stance] remains the most viable path forward.
S2 [整合全文两大支柱机制 Synthesize Dual Pillars]：By combining [Pillar 1 from Body 1] with [Pillar 2 / Safeguard from Body 2], [Actors] can harness [Core Benefit] while containing [Primary Risk].
S3 [理性边界展望（可选）Grounded Forward Look]：Ultimately, the success of [Technology/Policy] depends not on its standalone capability, but on the institutional rigor with which it is governed.

prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：IELTS_Task1_Process 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT15 (雅思小作文（Task 1）闭环工艺与算法流程图满分范文：具身智能遥操作数据采集、双支路增强与主动学习回环)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP25 -> BP29 -> BP30`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: Curating clean human data is very important. If we do not use clean human data and only use AI-generated data to train new AI models, the models will become worse and worse and finally collapse.
structural_constraints: S1 [正面基准命题 Positive Baseline]：Maintaining rigorous [Principle/Standard X] serves as the primary safeguard against [Systemic Risk Y].
S2 [反事实假设切入 Counterfactual Premise]：Absent this safeguard—if [Actors] were to rely exclusively on [Unchecked Alternative]—[Immediate Vulnerability] would quickly emerge.
S3 [连锁恶化传导 Cascading Deterioration]：Once [Immediate Vulnerability] takes hold, [Secondary Consequence] compounds across cycles, eventually eroding [Core Foundation].
S4 [实证印证或结论锁定 Empirical Echo]：This degradation dynamic mirrors [Real-world/Technical Precedent], underscoring why [Principle X] cannot be compromised for short-term convenience.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 结尾段
domain_context: 具身智能视觉运动策略与仿真到真实迁移
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写六级、雅思 Task 2 或托福独立写作的结尾段（Conclusion）：用 2–3 句话收束全文，做到既呼应中心论点、整合正反权衡，又绝不喊假大空口号（Let us work together for a better tomorrow）。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP40` 与全文样板 `FT15` 的后半部分（``），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: We use ETT, Weather, Electricity, and Traffic datasets. We compare with Autoformer, PatchTST, iTransformer, and DLinear. We use MSE and MAE as metrics, and the lookback window is 96.
structural_constraints: S1 [重申核心权衡与立场 Restate Nuanced Thesis]：In conclusion, while [Acknowledged Factor A] introduces real challenges in [Specific Aspect], [Core Thesis Stance] remains the most viable path forward.
S2 [整合全文两大支柱机制 Synthesize Dual Pillars]：By combining [Pillar 1 from Body 1] with [Pillar 2 / Safeguard from Body 2], [Actors] can harness [Core Benefit] while containing [Primary Risk].
S3 [理性边界展望（可选）Grounded Forward Look]：Ultimately, the success of [Technology/Policy] depends not on its standalone capability, but on the institutional rigor with which it is governed.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
